run_plot_training_loss: run plot_log.py with --experiment DIR to plot training loss curves from DeepSDF logs
run_plot_learning_rate: run plot_log.py with --experiment DIR --type learning_rate to plot learning rate curves
run_plot_timing: run plot_log.py with --experiment DIR --type time to plot per-epoch timing data
run_plot_latent_magnitude: run plot_log.py with --experiment DIR --type lat_mag to plot latent vector magnitude over epochs
run_plot_param_magnitude: run plot_log.py with --experiment DIR --type param_mag to plot parameter magnitude over epochs
